Interpretation_Rule: Structure-specific 0 K calculated SFE for an FCC model. The tensile starting structure after quench is BCC-dominant.
Negative SFE is used by authors to discuss SF/TRIP propensity; do not merge with finite-temperature experimental SFE.
This is BCC unstable stacking-fault/slip-barrier energy, not the same descriptor as FCC stable SFE.
Keep separate from FCC gamma_sf and from all experimental SFE methods.
